newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends up on technical adjustment.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends up on technical adjustment.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were quoted higher at the close on technical adjustment but trading was practically nil due to an absence of buyers, traders said.
"There's been no dealing or inquiries through the day," said a trader.
At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted March RSS1 buyer at 301 cents ($1.21) a kg, up one cent from Tuesday. March SMR 20 ended 1.50 cents higher at 295.50 cents.
Trading houses offered drum latex at 235.50 cents a kg, SMR CV at 358, SMR L at 338, SMR 5 at 305, SMR 10 at 294 and SMR 20 at 293.
The INRO five-day average was 232.70 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Feb 25 from 233.56 on Feb 24. The daily indicator was at 230.99 against 231.42.
